items.question: According to the UAE's free stem-cell therapy initiative for critical COVID-19 patients, how many COVID-19 patients in the UAE were treated with the therapy?
items.gold: The treatment was administered to 73 COVID-19 patients in the UAE.
items.fact: Stem-cell therapy initiative treated 73 COVID-19 patients in UAE

items.question: As of July 2021, to how many countries around the world did the UAE send medical aid under its global efforts to combat COVID-19?
items.gold: The UAE sent medical aid to 135 countries around the world.
items.fact: UAE COVID-19 global aid reached 135 countries by July 2021
